subject: CoDi status: SR repro solid, 1-step quality is the open risk
body:
Hi Ivo, Zofia,

Status. SR repro landed March 19: our 4-step distilled model is within 0.8 FID and 0.004 LPIPS of the 50-step teacher on the real-world super-resolution benchmark, consistent with the paper. Inpainting distillation with the parameter-efficient variant is training now and early numbers look like they will beat the 50-step baseline, as the paper reports.

The risk is the marketing ask for a 1-step mode. At 1 step, FID degrades by ~6 points on SR and artifacts are visible in hair/texture regions; 2 steps is noticeably better but still short of 4. I recommend we ship the demo defaulting to 4 steps, expose 1-2 steps behind an "experimental" toggle, and keep the headline claim at 4-step parity. Overpromising 1-step will bite us in the launch review.

InstructPix2Pix setting starts next week - Tereza's condition-encoder refactor unblocked it.

Csilla
